Curriculum.title: Professional summary focused on product and backend engineering
Curriculum.summary: Software Engineer specialized in Full-Stack development with a focus on process automation and digitalization of document-based workflows. With experience in university, industrial and remote tech company environments, I have built web and desktop systems that reduce operational times and human error. Competent in database design and modeling, clean architectures (Clean Architecture, SOLID) and software delivery oriented to measurable results. Fluent management of the complete development cycle: from requirements gathering to production deployment.
Curriculum.highlight1: End-to-end development: from requirements gathering to production deployment with clean architectures.
Curriculum.highlight2: Specialization in encrypted databases (SQLCipher/AES-256) and scalable multi-tenant systems.
Curriculum.highlight3: Operational process automation with reduction from 10 minutes to less than 1 minute.

Experience.title: Experience
Experience.exp1Description: Cross-platform client development with Flutter/Dart for Android, iOS and Desktop. Implementation of Clean Architecture with Provider for session management and role control. Integration of interactive vector animations with Rive engine and Glassmorphism design. Participation in full-stack with Next.js in the web layer of the system. Reactive state management and decoupled architecture oriented to scalability.
Experience.exp1Technologies: Flutter, Dart, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Clean Architecture, Provider, Rive
Experience.exp1Achievement1: Reduced app load time by 40% through optimized state management
Experience.exp1Achievement2: Implemented role-based access control for 500+ concurrent users
Experience.exp1Achievement3: Delivered cross-platform solution with 95% code reuse across iOS, Android and Desktop
Experience.exp2Description: LogMaster — Access Control and Visitor Management System. Requirements gathering and operational process analysis. Design and modeling of encrypted database with SQLCipher (AES-256-GCM). Development of multiplatform desktop application (Electron + React + TypeScript) and web version. Automation of managerial processes with complete digital record. Integration of PDF and Excel report generator. Reduction of process execution time: from up to 10 minutes to less than 1 minute. Implementation of differentiated roles: Administrator, Guard and Auditor.
Experience.exp2Technologies: Electron, React, TypeScript, SQLCipher, AES-256, Node.js, PostgreSQL
Experience.exp2Achievement1: Reduced process execution time from 10 minutes to under 1 minute (90% improvement)
Experience.exp2Achievement2: Implemented AES-256-GCM encryption securing 10,000+ sensitive records
Experience.exp2Achievement3: Automated reporting system generating 200+ PDF/Excel reports monthly

services.title: Fast Backend for Startups and MVPs

services.idealFor: Teams that need low-latency services or robust CLI tools

terms.title: Service terms
terms.providers: We use Contabo for projects requiring a VPS. Namecheap is our primary domain provider; Hostinger or Vercel are alternatives subject to availability. Compatible apps may be hosted on Vercel. Services are purchased through client-owned accounts.
terms.externalCosts: Hosting, VPS, domains and renewals, licenses, paid APIs, fees and publishing accounts are paid by the client. Initial setup is included only when stated in the scope.
terms.basePrice: The starting price covers this base package only. Final scope and budget are agreed in writing before work begins.
terms.paymentMethods: PayPal, Zinli, Binance and Airtm. Payment details, currency and applicable fees are confirmed before payment.
terms.revisionPolicy: A round is one consolidated list of adjustments to the agreed work. New screens, modules or integrations are quoted separately.
terms.warranty: Software deliveries include 30 days to fix reproducible defects against the contracted scope. New features and third-party changes are excluded. Diagnostics include report clarifications, not code fixes.
terms.maintenance: Ongoing maintenance is contracted separately. Monthly plan revisions consume included hours; server uptime and 24/7 support are not guaranteed.
terms.timing: Timelines start once the deposit, content, access and requirements are received. Client delays or approved changes adjust the schedule. Deliveries are validated against the agreed scope.

payment.milestones: 40% upfront, 30% after functional demo acceptance and 30% after final delivery acceptance.
payment.upfront: 100% upfront. Maintenance is paid at the start of each monthly period.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This site is the personal portfolio of Gustavo Colina. This page explains what data is collected when you visit it and how it is used.
Privacy.dataForm: Contact form: when submitted, your name, email and message are sent directly to my inbox via EmailJS. Nothing is stored on any server of mine.
Privacy.dataAnalytics: Site analytics: I use Vercel Analytics, which does not use cookies or collect personally identifiable data; it only aggregates anonymous traffic statistics.
Privacy.thirdParties: EmailJS (email delivery) and Vercel Analytics (usage statistics). Both process data under their own privacy policies.
Privacy.rights: You can request the deletion of any information you sent through the contact form by writing to me directly.
Privacy.contact: For any questions about this policy, write to me at
